description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface includes four pure virtual methods intended to handle various events related to runtime, window management, ripple events, and state changes.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling different system events which must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: onRuntimeManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles runtime management related events, receives event data as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onWindowManagerEvent
methods.description: Handles window management related events, receives event data as a JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onRippleEvent
methods.description: Handles ripple related events, receives a event name and data as JsonObject reference.

methods.name: onStateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles general state change events, receives event data as a JsonObject reference.
